paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates GPU memory usage for different methods, labeled “Full FT,” “MTL-FT,” “TAG,” “Adapter,” “QAdapter,” and “Ours.” The horizontal axis displays the method names, listed without any apparent order, and the vertical axis represents GPU Memory in GB, using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, and 60. Each method is represented by a single yellow or green bar. The “Full FT” bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 61 GB, while the “Ours” bar is the shortest, measuring roughly 14 GB. The “MTL-FT” bar reaches a height of approximately 43 GB, the “TAG” bar reaches approximately 29 GB, the “Adapter” bar reaches approximately 10 GB, and the “QAdapter” bar reaches approximately 17 GB. The “Ours” bar is colored green, while all other bars are colored yellow. No bars appear to be visually emphasized or annotated.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates GPU memory usage for different adapter methods. The horizontal axis represents the method name, labeled as “Full FT”, “MTL-FT”, “TAG”, “QAdapter”, “Adapter”, and “Ours”, displayed in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and represents memory usage in gigabytes, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, and tick labels at 0, 20, 40, and 60.  There are six individual bars, all colored either orange or green. “Full FT” is represented by an orange bar with an approximate height of 61 GB, while “MTL-FT” is represented by an orange bar with a height of approximately 44 GB. “TAG” demonstrates an orange bar of around 21 GB in height, followed by a yellow “QAdapter” bar about 12 GB tall.  “Adapter” has a yellow bar with around 9 GB, and finally, “Ours” is indicated by a green bar measuring approximately 16 GB in height. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
